Command.Statement: SELECT Hierarchize({DrilldownLevel({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[All Diagnoses by ICD-10 Chapter]},,,INCLUDE_CALC_MEMBERS)}) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME ON COLUMNS FROM (SELECT Filter([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[Level 04].AllMembers, ([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.member_caption>="E00" AND [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.member_caption<="I99")) ON COLUMNS FROM [ZCLHIER]) WHERE ([Measures].[ZCLVISNO]) CELL PROPERTIES VALUE, FORMAT_STRING, LANGUAGE, BACK_COLOR, FORE_COLOR, FONT_FLAGS
